proposed_widenings.name: modify_size
proposed_widenings.justification: The 'reduce' effect's primary mechanic is a one-category size reduction. No v4 atom or EffectAtom variant covers creature size modification. transform_target (full polymorph) is too broad — this retains the original stat block and only shifts the size category.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain the 'reduce' effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell — The creature's size decreases one size category

proposed_widenings.name: DurationValue.amount as DiceExpr
proposed_widenings.justification: DurationValue.amount is typed as number, but the potion's duration is '1d4 hours' — a random roll resolved at drink time. No existing DurationValue variant supports a dice-rolled amount.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain the 'reduce' effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 1d4 hours

notes: Two distinct gaps block honest encoding. Primary: no atom for creature size category change — the reduce effect's defining mechanic. Secondary: DurationValue.amount cannot hold a dice expression (1d4 hours). The disadvantage on Str checks/saves (modify_roll_advantage) and -1d4 weapon damage (modify_damage_numeric) would encode cleanly, but omitting the size reduction would produce a materially misleading trace. Potion mechanics (single use, no attunement, never-reset, permanent_on_empty destruction, utilize activation) all fit the existing surface.
